summary: AI engineer with three years of production delivery in banking and government visa systems, promoted to Senior Software Engineer. experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Rebuilt the refund review flow of a visa-processing platform off a legacy stack onto React and Node. Reviewers work claims across 60+ government contracts, each with its own fee rules.
Cut API response time 40% and database load 35% on the banking platform by collapsing redundant core calls into one aggregate response per screen.
Ran releases and production support across both accounts, and mentored junior engineers.

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Built the React and TypeScript front end for a US private-client bank's digital channel platform during a core banking migration, on a system handling millions of transactions a day.
Wrote the Node.js layer between that front end and the bank's core. It shaped core responses per screen and kept tokens and session handling off the browser.
Engineered a performance-optimised document processing pipeline, resolving a critical bottleneck and contributing to €12k+ additional revenue.

experience.title: Web Developer Intern
highlights: Supported CMS-driven web builds and front-end enhancements for B2B marketing sites.
Focused on CSS and JavaScript for rapid iteration and page performance.
